summary: Greg Johnson's funky alien roguelike/action series, from the Genesis cult original through the Xbox third game and the modern Back in the Groove revival.

entries.title: ToeJam & Earl
entries.definitive_edition: SEGA Genesis - Nintendo Switch Online release

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Switch Online Genesis app or Genesis hardware/emulation
emulation.notes: Use Switch Online for modern save/rewind convenience.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Genesis/Mega Drive presentation with official emulator features.

primary.version: SEGA Genesis - Nintendo Switch Online release
primary.why: The original Genesis game is now available through Nintendo Classics/Switch Online, with modern save/rewind/online-sharing features and Switch 2 compatibility support, making it the current official route for the first game.
primary.how_to_play: Play through the SEGA Genesis - Nintendo Switch Online app with an Expansion Pack membership. Use the Genesis cartridge or Sega Vintage Collection releases only for historical comparison or ownership convenience.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is official emulation of the Genesis release, not a remaster.

entries.title: ToeJam & Earl III: Mission to Earth

emulation.notes: Use original hardware for the most reliable peripheral/profile compatibility.

primary.why: Mission to Earth was released only for the original Xbox after earlier Dreamcast/Nintendo 64 concepts were canceled, so the Xbox disc is the complete official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original Xbox release on compatible Xbox hardware. Treat the preserved Dreamcast prototype as archival, not the primary official play route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official remaster or rerelease is documented; the Dreamcast build is a prototype/community archival release, not a retail platform.

entries.title: ToeJam & Earl: Back in the Groove

emulation.notes: Use PC for capture; controller choice is preference.

primary.why: Back in the Groove released on PC, Mac, Linux, Switch, PS4, and Xbox One; the Windows PC version is the most capture-flexible route for the modern revival, with the same core content and online/local co-op.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version for the main run and capture. Use Switch for portable/local co-op convenience or console versions if that is where the party setup lives.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a new fourth entry and revival, not a remaster of the Genesis original.
